title: Implement wp11_backend_fs_dir.c
description: New opt-in backend that scans a configured directory for .p11k files and presents each as a PKCS#11 slot. Reuses wp11_keystore.c for AES-GCM load/save. Analogous to wp11_backend_usb_flash.c but without USB hotplug: scan directory at C_Initialize, optionally use inotify to pick up files added/removed at runtime (C_WaitForSlotEvent). New files: src/wp11_backend_fs_dir.c, wolfp11/wp11_backend_fs_dir.h.
